newsitem.title: USA: Telex Communications sells $125 mln in junk bonds.
newsitem.headline: Telex Communications sells $125 mln in junk bonds.

text.p: The following 144a offering of high-yield bonds from Telex Communications Inc was priced on Wednesday via Chase Securities Inc, according to market sources.

Proceeds from the offering will be used to finance a leveraged buyout of the company by Greenwich Street Capital Partners as well as to refinance $100 million in outstanding Telex 12 percent senior notes due 2004.
Telex is a Minneapolis, Minn.-based manufacturer of audio, wireless and multimedia communications products.

The notes are being issued by GST Acquisition Corp, an entity set up solely for the purpose of carrying out the buyout of Telex. Upon consumation of the transaction, Telex Communciations will be the obligor of the bonds.
ISSUER GST ACQUISITION CORP (Telex Communications Inc)
NOTES: THREE-YEAR EQUITY CALL FOR 1/3 OF THE ISSUE AT 110.50
